verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence is that Auth0's Private Cloud offering includes "dev instances" alongside production isolation (auth0-docs-48). This is a thin, enterprise-deployment-scoped mention rather than a documented sandbox/test environment workflow. The free plan (auth0-docs-105) suggests separate tenants are easy to obtain but is not described as a sandbox. Missing for 10: documented dev/staging tenant or sandbox environment for all plans, guidance on isolating test data from production, test-mode tooling usable by agents/CLI/MCP, independent or hands-on corroboration.
